# BrainMD

> BrainMD offers science-backed brain health supplements formulated by Dr. Daniel G. Amen to support memory, focus, mood, sleep, and energy.

BrainMD specializes in clinical-grade brain supplements featuring proprietary and clinically-validated ingredients like Affron® Saffron, KSM-66® Ashwagandha, LONGVIDA® Curcumin, and PEAK ATP®. The site provides personalized product recommendations through the Brain Type Quiz and emphasizes NSF Certification and Dr. Amen's expert formulations.
